NOT for whole-repo alert audits or bulk dismissal — it never closes alerts for you and never replaces the Code Scanning suite. NOT for Java/JS/Go (Python only today). The prefilter lists candidate sensitive NAMES in files/dirs you point at; it draws no conclusion and produces no audit report. Keywords — CodeQL, Code Scanning, taint source, data flow, SARIF, codeFlows, false positive, py/clear-text-storage-sensitive-data, CWE-312.
